data.content: ["Surfside Beach offers a relaxed, low-cost coastal escape with excellent outdoor opportunities and food scenes, perfect for leisurely mornings and scenic walks without the crowds or nightlife pressure.", "Clearwater Beach combines beautiful outdoor activities and dining experiences with a well-established food culture where Alice can find Italian options, all at a relaxed pace away from club-heavy nightlife.", "Finger Lakes provides scenic walking trails through wine country with charming local dining including Italian restaurants, ideal for a slow-paced getaway focused on natural beauty and gastronomic experiences.", "Matagorda delivers authentic Texas beach relaxation with maximum outdoor time and minimal nightlife distractions, allowing the group to enjoy leisurely days, quality meals, and scenic coastal walks without early-morning pressures.", "Lincoln City offers a charming small-city atmosphere with good local food, accessible museums and galleries for Carol, scenic coastal walks, and a naturally relaxed vibe that discourages overScheduling while accommodating Alice's late-morning preference."]
